name: bike-posts-backend
description: Microservices backend for bike posts application

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:user" "npm run dev:post" "npm run dev:ai" "npm run dev:interaction"
scripts.deploy:all: npm run deploy:user && npm run deploy:post && npm run deploy:ai && npm run deploy:interaction
scripts.deploy:user: cd services/user-service && gcloud run deploy user-service --source . --region asia-south1
scripts.deploy:post: cd services/post-service && gcloud run deploy post-service --source . --region asia-south1
scripts.deploy:ai: cd services/ai-service && gcloud run deploy ai-service --source . --region asia-south1
scripts.deploy:interaction: cd services/interaction-service && gcloud run deploy interaction-service --source . --region asia-south1
